$comment: R35 (P2/P3): canonical module -> configuration dependency manifest. Read by scripts/feature-readiness.mjs (read-only doctor) and checked by tests/unit/r35-activation-manifest.test.js against the environment reads of the code (scripts/lib/env-inventory.mjs) and against the owner guide. Names only, never values. 'gaps' are implementation gaps that close themselves when the 'fixed_when' pattern appears in the file. 'gates' are legal / privacy / owner decisions; the doctor never clears one: a gate is cleared only by its approval variable or by an explicit owner decision recorded here with a date.

BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.note: owner workstation only (backups), never on Vercel

ADA_BETA_OPEN_SURFACES.note: R35: comma list of surfaces opened during the beta (accounts, pro, institution, appointments, video, communications, documents, diagnostic, admin, jobs); unset = none; the release gate then requires their services

ADA_PRO_SELF_REGISTRATION.note: R43 (E1): public structure self-registration (POST /api/pro/auth/register creates a Structure + its STRUCTURE_ADMIN). Closed unless « open »: during the beta even when « pro » is open, and in Production outside the beta (handler). Members join by invitation; the first SUPERADMIN comes from scripts/pro-superadmin-bootstrap.mjs

ADA_BETA_ACCOUNTS_SCOPE.note: R43 (E2): what the « accounts » surface opens during the beta. Unset = booking scope (auth/*, citizen profile, age-declaration, email-change(-confirm), phone, preferences, restriction, espace); « full » = the whole citizen space (household, guardians, push, shares, parcours, favorites, history, delegations, referrals)

ADA_CAPABILITIES_OPEN.note: R45 (ENG-LR-6): comma list of capabilities OUTSIDE the AIPD to open (api/_utils/capabilities.js, CONTROL/r45/R45_CAPABILITY_GATES_EN.md). Unset = none; exact names, unknown names open nothing, no wildcard. The capability’s surface must be open too; a requiresHds capability also needs ADA_HDS_CERTIFIED_HOSTING. Set only after the controller extends the AIPD

ADA_HDS_CERTIFIED_HOSTING.note: R45 (ENG-LR-6): attestation token of a certified health-data host (HDS), HDS1:<provider-slug>:<certificate-reference>:<valid-until YYYY-MM-DD>:<sha256 of the certificate document>. Malformed or expired = no HDS capability opens. A recorded statement by the controller, not a verification; unset until a certified host exists

ADA_CAPABILITY_ENFORCEMENT.note: R45 (ENG-LR-6): « 1 » turns the capability gates on in a LAB / test run. Production, Preview and the restricted beta enforce them whatever this says (no value turns them off there)

ADA_BETA_OPEN_JOBS.note: R38: comma list of scheduled jobs opened ONE AT A TIME during the beta (actualites, health-alert, ingest-structures, ingest-aids; personal-data jobs also need ADA_JOBS_APPROVED; legacy jobs can never be opened by name); unset = none

ADA_GUEST_BOOKING_ENABLED.note: R38: account-free booking, off unless true; owner decision after legal/privacy/mail requirements

ADA_JOBS_APPROVED.note: R38: the personal-data jobs the owner approved (parcours-reminder, referral-timeouts, rdv-reminder, gdpr-purge): legal basis, retention and a working mail provider recorded first; unset = none

ADA_CSP_REPORTS.note: R42 (F8): CSP violation reports. log = POST /api/monitor/csp-report passes the beta gate and a minimised summary (directive, blocked origin, page path template, disposition) goes to the server log only; off = refused. Unset: on in LAB (VERCEL_ENV development/preview), off in Production

ADA_CSP_REPORT_SAMPLE.note: R42 (F8): share of CSP reports kept when ADA_CSP_REPORTS=log, in (0, 1]; unset or invalid = 1

VITE_PUBLIC_BETA_OPEN_SURFACES.note: R35: the same list for the browser screens (rebuild); must match ADA_BETA_OPEN_SURFACES

VITE_PUBLIC_BETA_ACCOUNTS_SCOPE.note: R43: the same scope for the browser screens (rebuild); must match ADA_BETA_ACCOUNTS_SCOPE

VITE_PUBLIC_BETA_PRO_SELF_REGISTRATION.note: R43: shows the /pro/register screen during the beta (rebuild); must match ADA_PRO_SELF_REGISTRATION

ALERT_EMAIL.note: R36: the address that receives operational alerts by e-mail through the site's mail provider; ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL or ALERT_EMAIL is enough

ALERT_MAIL_BOUNCE_BURST.note: R44-MAIL: bounces + suppressions (or refused events) per hour reported by the Mailjet delivery events that raise an alert in cron/health-alert (default 10); only read while MAILER_EVENTS_ENABLED=1

MAILER_MSGRAPH_TENANT_ID.note: R42-MAIL: only with MAILER_PROVIDER=msgraph — Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of the Microsoft 365 organisation

MAILER_MSGRAPH_CLIENT_ID.note: R42-MAIL: Application (client) ID of the app registration; Mail.Send granted ONLY through an Exchange RBAC for Applications assignment scoped to the sender mailbox

MAILER_MSGRAPH_SENDER.note: R42-MAIL: the one mailbox the app sends as (a shared mailbox, no licence); defaults to the address of MAILER_FROM

MAILER_MSGRAPH_CERT_PRIVATE_KEY.note: R42-MAIL: PEM private key of the app certificate (preferred credential)

MAILER_MSGRAPH_CERT_PEM.note: R42-MAIL: PEM public certificate uploaded to the app registration (its SHA-256 thumbprint is computed)

MAILER_MSGRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET.note: R42-MAIL: client secret, only if no certificate is used (expires; rotate before its end date)

MAILER_MAILJET_SANDBOX.note: R43-MAIL: 1 = Mailjet SandboxMode: every message is validated by Mailjet and NONE is delivered (outcome SANDBOX_VALIDATED, ledger TEST_RECORDED); mail stays not deliverable

MAILER_REPLY_TO.note: R43-MAIL: Reply-To of every message (e.g. contact@accesdirectaide.fr): replies reach a read mailbox, the sender address needs none

MAILER_EVENTS_ENABLED.note: R43-MAIL: 1 = the Mailjet delivery-event webhook POST /api/monitor/mail-events/mailjet is on (default off: 404) and hard bounces / complaints suppress the address

MAILER_EVENTS_BASIC_USER.note: R43-MAIL: only with MAILER_EVENTS_ENABLED=1 — user of the basic-auth pair written in the Mailjet event callback URL

MAILER_EVENTS_BASIC_PASSWORD.note: R43-MAIL: only with MAILER_EVENTS_ENABLED=1 — password (>= 24 random characters) of the Mailjet event callback URL; rotate by changing it in Vercel and in Mailjet

OUTLOOK_ENABLED.note: the release gate fails on true until the gate is changed in code

STORAGE_PUBLIC_URL.note: read by the test runner only

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.note: no longer read since R35 (the pro health page reads STORAGE_*)

ENABLE_AI_AGENT.note: opens pro/admin agent routes; must not be 'true' in production (no approved AI provider there)

GDPR_PURGE_ENABLED.note: do not create before the retention periods (D4) are approved

GDPR_PURGE_POLICY_VERSION.note: R44 / E16: the retention policy version this deployment was approved for (api/_services/retention-policy.js); the policy itself must be APPROVED in code — do not create before D4

GDPR_PURGE_APPROVED_STEPS.note: R44 / E16: explicit list of the purge step ids the controller approved (no wildcard); every other step stays a dry run — do not create before D4

ADA_SENSITIVE_BOOKING_APPROVED.note: R45 (ENG-LR-2): exact value art9-explicit-consent-v1 records the controller's approval of the art. 9(2)(a) explicit-consent basis for sensitive-service booking (D2 P5s). With ADA_HDS_BOOKING_ASSESSED=1 it opens sensitive booking; any other value keeps it closed. Unset until counsel review, D2 and the AIPD update

ADA_HDS_BOOKING_ASSESSED.note: R45 (ENG-LR-2): « 1 » records that the HDS assessment of sensitive-service booking is done (CONTROL/r45/R45_HDS_FEATURE_MATRIX_FR.md rows 4–5). A recorded statement, not a verification; unset

ADA_SENSITIVITY_REVIEW_ENFORCED.note: R45 (ENG-LR-2): « 1 » refuses booking of unreviewed services in a LAB / test run. Production, Preview and the restricted beta always refuse them (no value turns it off there)

ADA_PROTECTED_STORE.note: R46: storage driver of the HDS-relevant blobs (api/lib/protected-store/CONTRACT.md). « lab » is refused in production / preview; « certified » needs ADA_PROTECTED_STORE_ENDPOINT / _TOKEN and, there, a valid ADA_HDS_CERTIFIED_HOSTING

FRANCECONNECT_ISSUER.note: R46 / N08: OIDC issuer of FranceConnect (after the DataPass habilitation); unset = FranceConnect unavailable

ADA_PROTECTED_RECORDS.note: R46: the controller states that the PostgreSQL holding the protected case records (ProCaseNote) is on the certified (HDS) host. Production / preview refuse case notes (503 PROTECTED_STORE_REFUSED) unless this AND a valid ADA_HDS_CERTIFIED_HOSTING are set (api/_services/pro-protected-records.js). A statement, not a verification; unset until a certified host exists
